title: A full weighted endpoint law is stronger than an unbiased scalar count
statement: Positive dimension d=p rplus min(M,Kcut+1); Q=[O(1+beta n Lambda+log(d/epsQ))]^d yields n^{O(d)},not fixed-parameter f(d)n^c. Fixed positive dimension/physical margin and V=O(log n) give polynomial negative overhead,not general signed low-temperature tractability. Trace residual requires O(1/n) operator rounding because error n(eta+epsilon); clipping/positive-rank/decomposition certificates paid. Each node needs center,shifted positive count and acceptance statistics O(a0^-1 eps_a^-2 log1/eta_a); changed constraints may need all-new guides. Weighted full path endpoint identity E[Yminus f(Xend)]=Zminus E_pi_minus f is required. Actual mixture rho_j proportional omega_j Chat_j uses full negative guide: multiplying extra Z0,j double-counts. Checked moments E(Yminus/Zminus)^k<=Rk a0^-k,clipping tau<=2^(4-2k)Rk/a0 and acceptance>=a0(1-tau)/16; finite cap ceil[16 log(1/eta_cap)/(a0(1-tau))]. Once centers/coarse guides acquired,further draws need not revisit Q; AIS length O(nk^2),k=O(log1/tau+V),rejection exp(O(V)); categorical lookup,reversible work and feature arithmetic remain paid without free QRAM.

evidence.quote: The main advance is a broader conditional algorithm, not another small numerical fixture. For the acquired decomposition `J=D0+S+A_+A_+^T-N`, the positive conditional variance inequality gives the all-tilt trace bound `Tr Cov(Y_-) <= p beta Tr(N)/(1-alpha)`. Conditional independence between sites, not between times within a site, makes the trace sum `p M delta=p beta`. This removes time-mesh size from the negative rejection exponent while still charging vector dimension, sampling and arithmetic. A finite sampled center and the correctly shifted positive normalizer supply the construction; an optimal-center oracle is not assumed.
